boxing.jaymoskingdoms.begin.0: Fists, is it? Then show me. Wrap your hands and put down %2$s things that mean you harm, with nothing but your hands. Come back when it is done.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.begin.1: You want to learn? Words teach nothing. %2$s foes, hands only, wraps on. Then we talk.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.begin.2: I will not teach an untried hand, %1$s. Bring down %2$s that would kill you, bare knuckle and wraps. Then come to me.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.learning.0: Not yet, %1$s. %2$s more, with your hands.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.learning.1: You are not done. %2$s still stand between you and a lesson.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.learning.2: Hands only, and %2$s more. I can wait.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.learned.0: There. You have hit and been hit, and you came back. Now stand as I stand. This is how my people fight.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.learned.1: Good. Your hands know what they are for now. Watch my feet, then my shoulders. This is the way of it.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.learned.2: So you can take a blow, %1$s. Then here is how to give one. Stand like this.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.one_at_a_time.0: One way at a time, %1$s. Finish what you began before you ask for another.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.one_at_a_time.1: You carry a way of fighting half learned. Master it. Then come back.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.one_at_a_time.2: A second stance on unsteady feet? No. Learn the first to its end.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.taken_up.0: You have stood this way before. Stand so again.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.taken_up.1: Back to the old stance, %1$s? It has not forgotten you.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.taken_up.2: Good. Your shoulders remember. Fight this way for now.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_0.0: You have gone as far as easy fights will take you. Find the dead that walk in armour and break %2$s of them, hands only.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_0.1: Soft targets teach soft hands. %2$s armoured dead, %1$s. Fists and nothing else.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_0.2: Now something that does not fall at a touch. %2$s of the armoured dead, with your hands.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_1.0: The dead are slow. An orc is not. Bring one down with your hands and tell me how it felt.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_1.1: You are ready for something that hits back in earnest, %1$s. An orc. Fists only.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_1.2: Go and find an orc. Stand in front of it. Come back without a weapon ever leaving your belt.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_2.0: One thing left. A camp's chief, or a bandit who lives by the blade. Beat one with your hands.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_2.1: There is nothing more I can show you until you have beaten a chief or a bandit, bare handed.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_2.2: The last of it, %1$s. A chief of the camps, or a bandit. Your hands against their steel.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_wait.1: You know what I asked. %2$s to go.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.task_wait.2: Come back when it is finished. %2$s still.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.train.0: Keep fighting, %1$s. A stance is learned against something that hits back.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.train.1: Nothing to tell you today. Go and be hit, and hit harder.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.train.2: You are coming along. The rest is in the doing.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.mastered.0: I have nothing left to teach you in this. Another of my kind might show you another way.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.mastered.1: You stand better than I do now, %1$s. Seek out another people's teacher if you want more.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.mastered.2: That is all of it. There are other ways to make a fist, among other peoples.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.129: Wrap your hands in rags and ask an old one or a seasoned guard to speak of the fist. They will ask something of you first.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.130: With wrapped hands and a way of fighting learned, the Dodge key slips or pulls you clear instead of rolling. Time it well and your next blow lands hard.
